body.p: at the Phase 0 gate review. The original file skipped (no commit ever used the number); the plan's risk table names a "Time-boxed Phase 0" without a length, so this record fills it. Phase 0 is time-boxed to two weeks from its start (2026-10-16 to 2026-10-30). When the box ends, open design questions are written down as decision records or "Proposed" items and design stops; they are not a reason to extend Phase 0. Phase 0 closed on its first day, well inside the box.
